# DataUnchain

> DataUnchain is an on-premise AI document data extraction system that eliminates manual data entry from invoices, delivery notes, and contracts. The AI runs entirely on your hardware — no cloud, no external servers, no data ever leaving your network. 95.5% field-level accuracy tested on 219 real Italian business documents. 18 ERP connectors ready.

DataUnchain is built for small and medium businesses, accounting firms, and logistics companies that process high volumes of business documents. It connects directly to the ERP or accounting software already in use, without requiring migration or cloud subscriptions. The product is developed and maintained by Antonio Trento, an Italian developer based in Italy.

- [Roadmap](https://dataunchain.com/en/roadmap/): Development roadmap and upcoming features
